hypotheses.J0_native_branch_matches_checkpoint: The independently executed native variant matches checkpoint logits with maximum absolute error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.J1_fine128_composes_through_six_layers: Fine-128 retains at least 40 percent KL recovery when executed simultaneously in Layers 0-5.
hypotheses.J2_fine32_retains_nontrivial_six_layer_b: Fine-32 retains at least 10 percent KL recovery when executed simultaneously in Layers 0-5.
hypotheses.J3_larger_fine_program_dominates: Fine-128 has higher KL recovery than fine-32 at every prefix depth.
hypotheses.J4_broad_closure_improves_joint_program: At least one 32-type closure exceeds fine-32 KL recovery for the full six-layer program.
hypotheses.J5_programs_do_not_depend_on_native_inte: Fine-128 recovery remains positive at every prefix depth under closed-loop execution on its own perturbed states.
